title: Murmuration — Boids Flock Studio
description: A living flock sandbox — three tunable species, a hunting predator, wind, paintable walls, and painterly trails you can export or share.
concept: A real-time Reynolds boids simulation with a spatial-hash grid for performance. Three independently-tunable species flock, avoid a hunting predator you can unleash, and steer around obstacles you paint by hand, all while leaving long exposure-style trails behind them.
features: Three tunable species with independent separation/alignment/cohesion/speed sliders
Toggleable predator AI that hunts the nearest boid and scatters the flock
Wall-painting tool for obstacle avoidance plus a cursor 'blow' tool for direct interaction
5 curated presets (Murmuration, School of Fish, Insect Swarm, Chaos, Calm Drift)
PNG export of the live trail canvas, localStorage autosave, and shareable URL-hash links

interaction.mouse: Drag to blow the flock around; switch to the Wall tool to paint obstacles
interaction.click: 🦅 unleashes or recalls a predator that hunts the nearest boid
interaction.touch: Same gestures via tap/drag, plus a collapsible ⚙ control panel
